title: Customer can pay for an order by card
description:
As a customer I want to pay for my basket by card so that I can complete my order.
Use the new payment provider. Card details are entered on our checkout page.
acceptanceCriteria:
- Customer can enter card details and pay
- Payment should be fast
- Show an error if the payment fails
- Order is marked as paid

parents.title: Online checkout
parents.description: Replace the phone-order process with self-service online checkout for UK customers.
